title: Love the Socks - and the great customer service!
text: I like the socks, they are comfortable and fit well.  I don't consider $12/pair to be excessive for a well made pair of socks.  I've gotten several compliments on my socks (really).  I did have an issue that Foot Cardigan resolved.  For the past two months they sent me duplicate versions of socks I'd already received.  I mentioned this in my review and Foot Cardigan sent me two new unique pairs.  I revised my review from 2 stars to 5 stars because they read my review and responded accordingly.
label: positive
